sections.text_helper: Section 24.1.2 "Interrupt and exception vectors" in chapter 24 (Nested vectored interrupt controller (NVIC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1117.
sections.section_content:
Exception vectors connected to the NVIC are the following: reset, NMI, HardFault,
MemManage, BusFault, UsageFault, SVCall, DebugMonitor, PendSV, and SysTick
